_note: Copy to docs/work/checklist/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<subject>.json. Never fill this file in place. status is pass|fail|skipped|substituted; substituted means checked by a different instrument than the item names, and its reason must say which. accepted stays null until a human answers it, so an unfinished run is visibly unfinished. Delete any item whose feature no longer exists rather than skipping it.

findings-against-prior-runs.prior-claim: status substituted, accepted: 'bank source was the owner's eval copy ~/ai-raccoon-eval/copies/cb99fe6ecbe0.db (live bank read denied by auto-mode classifier); same schema/content class'.
findings-against-prior-runs.what-is-actually-true: The verdict stands, but the two banks are not interchangeable and the run's own numbers must not be compared across them. This run measured the live-bank copy (25,243 entries, schema v19): CLAUDE.md paste 1.84 s, stopword paste 0.56 s. The eval copy (70,763 entries, schema v17): 11.6 s and 10.6 s. The 1.59.0 run's 12.0 s cold / 1.2 s warm was the eval copy too, so it reproduces here (11.6 s) and the live-bank figures are simply a smaller bank.
findings-against-prior-runs.evidence: live copy (1.07 GB, 25,243 entries): 1.84 s / 0.56 s. eval copy (809 MB, 70,763 entries): 11.6 s / 10.6 s. Pre-cap 1.56.0 on its own copy of the same eval bank: 22.2 s / 28.2 s.
findings-against-prior-runs.so-what: 'Returns in seconds' is true of the live bank's size and not of the eval copy's; the item's own acceptance depends on which bank it names, so the bank has to be named in the evidence every time.

findings-against-prior-runs.prior-claim: '1.56.0 in lane-a/tool-1560 on its own copy and fresh bank' -- the reason for 'its own copy' is not stated.
findings-against-prior-runs.what-is-actually-true: The separate copy is mandatory, not tidiness: 1.61.1 migrates a v17 bank to v19 when it opens it, and a v19 bank is then unopenable by 1.56.0 ('bank schema v19 is newer than this binary supports (v17)'). Serving the eval copy with 1.61.1 first cost the pre-cap control its bank until a second copy was taken from the still-v17 original.
findings-against-prior-runs.evidence: 1.56.0 on the copy 1.61.1 had already served: 'ai-raccoon: could not open the bank at .../ck/evalcopy/memory.db: bank schema v19 is newer than this binary supports (v17)'. A fresh copy of the original (PRAGMA user_version = 17) serves under 1.56.0 without complaint.
findings-against-prior-runs.so-what: Run the pre-cap control against its own copy, and take that copy BEFORE the current build touches the bank.

findings-against-prior-runs.prior-claim: status skipped -- 'Listing matches derived; calling every tool is out of scope here.'
findings-against-prior-runs.what-is-actually-true: The listing claim was right, but the item had not been driven, and driving it shows a constraint the listing cannot show: three tools (memory_set_ttl, memory_delete, memory_delete_context) refuse in the default rw access mode and need 'settings access set <projectId> full' first. Calling all 30 on 1.61.1: all answered with their documented success or typed refusal once the mode was raised.
findings-against-prior-runs.evidence: memory_set_ttl in rw mode: 'access-denied: memory_set_ttl requires mode full (current rw)'. After 'access set to full for project 01a15a2d-...': memory_set_ttl ok (ttlDays 30, canEverExpire false), memory_delete ok (deleted 1), memory_delete_context ok (deleted 0).
findings-against-prior-runs.so-what: A listing-only check cannot tell a reachable tool from a permanently refused one; the refusal names its own remedy, so the follow-up is one command.

findings-against-prior-runs.prior-claim: 'code_get/memory_sync success paths not exercised (no code index / sync target).'
findings-against-prior-runs.what-is-actually-true: Still true for memory_sync (no cloud target is configured in a scratch bank; it answers sync-not-configured, which is the documented refusal). The code_get success path IS reachable: ingesting a .cs file into a scoped corpus and searching kind=code returns a code hash that code_get then returns in full.
findings-against-prior-runs.evidence: code search (kind=code) on the scratch corpus: code[0].hash 9eec89ac...; code_get on it returns the full 'namespace AiRaccoon.Sample; ... Greet() ...' source.
findings-against-prior-runs.so-what: The gap was the absence of a code index, not a defect; the item is closable by ingesting a file first.

items.expected-result: a row the engine refuses is split from its batch and abandoned after three attempts; the other rows embed; the poison line count stops growing (ADR-0119)

After the first memory_embed_pending: {processed 4, pending 1}; sqlite 'embedded|0|4' and 'pending|3|1'; the poison row itself 'pending|3'. stub.log: 'ok 1', 'poison 5', 'ok 1' x4, 'poison 1' x3, 'ok 1', 'poison 1' x2, 'ok 1'. items.expected-result: on a bank of real scale a ~7,000-character paste returns in seconds at vectorWeight 0 and data.warning names the 64-distinct-word cap; a marker past 70 distinct filler words gets no hit, the same marker first gets an fts leg, repeats do not use up the cap, a 6-token query keeps the stopword 'the' and a 71-token query drops it (ADR-0126)
items.command: sqlite3 -readonly ~/.ai-raccoon/memory.db 'VACUUM INTO $SCRATCH/ck/livecopy/memory.db' (25,243 entries), watches deleted, served on port 62965; memory_search of CLAUDE.md[:7000] and of 7,000 stopword chars + 2 content words, both {vectorWeight: 0, minRelativeScore: 0, limit: 8}; cap probes on the fresh scratch bank at vectorWeight 0; pre-cap control: ai-raccoon 1.56.0 from nuget into a scratch --tool-path, serving its own copy of the eval bank (70,763 entries, schema v17) and the same two pastes; and the term-set probes on a 1.56.0 fresh bank

Probes on the fresh bank: marker first -> 1 hit, legs [fts]; marker last (71 tokens) -> 0 hits; marker after 80 repeats of two words -> 1 hit, legs [fts]; a 6-token query -> the 'the'-only note found, legs [fts]; a 71-token query -> 0 results, the 'the'-only note not found. Pre-cap 1.56.0 on its own copy of the eval bank (70,763 entries): CLAUDE.md paste 22.2 s, stopword paste 28.2 s. 1.56.0 on a fresh bank: the trailing marker IS found (legs [fts]) and the 71-token query DOES find the 'the'-only note. 1.61.1 on the same eval bank: 11.6 s and 10.6 s.

The cost figures depend on the bank's size, which the evidence names.
